这是最基本的深度图之一，T2I-Adapters 工作流程包含一个控制网络，如果您开始生成图像，您可以使用它。

该工作流程包括控制网络和其他不同的节点。 （测试和探索的基本配置）

在Confyui，深度图 T2I 适配器工作流程使用深度图来增强文本到图像 (T2I) 的生成，为生成的图像添加 3D 结构、距离和分层感。通过合并深度信息，该工作流程可生成具有更好透视和空间一致性的更真实的图像。下面详细介绍一下它的工作原理：

深度图生成：工作流程首先创建深度图，它表示图像中每个元素与观看者视角的距离。较暗的区域表示较近的元素，而较亮的区域表示较远的元素。 Confyui 可以根据输入提示生成此深度图，或者使用带有深度数据的现有图像（如果可用）。

深度感知图像生成：T2I 适配器在图像生成过程中合并此深度图，以确保模型应用准确的空间排列，从而提供逼真的深度效果。通过使用深度数据指导模型，工作流程有助于将对象定位在不同的平面上，从而在整个图像中保持准确的比例、比例和透视。

增强真实感和细节：有了深度信息，模型就可以添加与场景的预期 3D 结构相匹配的细节。阴影、照明和对象放置根据深度进行调整，从而形成更具凝聚力和可信度的构图。这也有助于避免标准 T2I 输出中常见的“扁平”外观，从而增加身临其境的 3D 质量。

选择性强调和聚焦：深度图可以根据用户的喜好选择性地强调前景或背景元素。例如，前景中的物体可以渲染出更清晰的细节，而背景可以稍微模糊或褪色，从而复制现实世界的景深效果。

基于提示的编辑的灵活性：用户可以更新提示以重新定位元素，同时保持深度布局，从而可以在不丢失场景空间布局的情况下快速修改。这对于创建同一场景的变体或对现有深度结构内的单个对象进行调整特别有用。

综上所述，深度图 T2I 适配器Confyui 中的工作流程通过添加深度数据来增强文本到图像的生成，确保准确的空间布局、透视和逼真的 3D 结构，创建更逼真的沉浸式深度感知图像。

This is one of the most basic depth map, T2I-Adapters workflows with a control-net included that you can use if you are starting to generate images.

This workflow includes a control-net and other different nodes to work with. (Basic configuration to test and explore)

In Confyui, theDepth Map T2I-Adaptersworkflow uses a depth map to enhance text-to-image (T2I) generation, adding a sense of 3D structure, distance, and layering to the resulting images. By incorporating depth information, this workflow produces more realistic images with better perspective and spatial consistency. Here’s a detailed look at how it works:

Depth Map Generation: The workflow begins by creating a depth map, which represents the distance of each element in the image from the viewer’s perspective. Darker areas indicate closer elements, while lighter areas represent those further away. Confyui can generate this depth map based on input prompts, or use an existing image with depth data if available.

Depth-Aware Image Generation: The T2I adapter incorporates this depth map during image generation to ensure that the model applies accurate spatial arrangements, giving a realistic depth effect. By guiding the model with depth data, the workflow helps position objects at different planes, maintaining accurate proportions, scale, and perspective throughout the image.

Enhanced Realism and Detail: With the depth information in place, the model can add details that match the intended 3D structure of the scene. Shadows, lighting, and object placement are adjusted based on depth, leading to a more cohesive and believable composition. This also helps avoid the “flat” look common in standard T2I outputs, adding an immersive 3D quality.

Selective Emphasis and Focus: The depth map enables selective emphasis on foreground or background elements, depending on the user’s preferences. For example, objects in the foreground can be rendered with sharper details, while the background can be slightly blurred or faded, replicating real-world depth of field effects.

Flexibility in Prompt-Based Edits: Users can update prompts to reposition elements while maintaining the depth layout, allowing for quick modifications without losing the scene’s spatial arrangement. This is especially useful for creating variations of the same scene or making adjustments to individual objects within the existing depth structure.

In summary, theDepth Map T2I-Adaptersworkflow in Confyui enhances text-to-image generation by adding depth data, ensuring accurate spatial layout, perspective, and realistic 3D structure, creating immersive, depth-aware images that feel more lifelike.
